description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). The engineer's decision on a proposal (propose_edits): the changes they accepted are applied to the saved text and saved (as update_draft saves), the rule-based checks run at once and the full check starts in the background. Only what the engineer accepted, never your own choice. Never publishes.

accept.description: The ids of the changes the engineer accepted

reject.description: The ids of the changes the engineer rejected

name: apply_edits
title: Apply the accepted changes
